convention: scene-linear radiance of a white diffuse surface, light only; three.js lightMapIntensity = pi reproduces the bake's exposure

uvLayer.name: Lightmap
uvLayer.orientation: glTF convention (v = 1 - v_blender), so the image rows run top-down and a loader must not flip them again

ground.uv: u runs along model +X from extent.x[0]; v runs along model +Y from extent.y[0]

placement.source: WORLD_LOCATIONS dreams (front: north) + replaceDreamsFallback in src/world/createWorld.ts: position (x, 0, z), rotation.y = PI

tubes.from: VISUAL_STYLE.lighting.coldWhite. Each of the eight fascia tubes is a mesh light; candelaEach is the bake's own exposure choice (the game's tube glow is an emissive/bloom cheat with no photometric value).

lamps.name: Streetlamp east (12, 29)
lamps.from: STREETLIGHTS [12, 29, sodium, 'curved']; yawTowardNearestRoad = +PI/2 (South perimeter road, z 25.5). The 'curved' model's emitter offset (1.172, 6.586, -0.038) rotated by that yaw gives streetlightEmitterWorld = (11.962, 6.586, 27.828). candela = VISUAL_STYLE.lighting.streetLightIntensity.

lamps.name: Streetlamp west (-12, 29)
lamps.from: STREETLIGHTS [-12, 29, sodium, 'curved'], same yaw and emitter offset.
